items.item: `Sources/Process/Process.Spawn.Capture.POSIX.swift`: on POSIX a timeout kills only the child, while Wi
items.reason: Took the issue's second option (test and document). Killing the process group is not possible from this package: ISO_9945.Kernel.Process.Spawn passes nil spawn attributes (or the shim's fixed isolated attributes), so POSIX_SPAWN_SETPGROUP cannot be requested, and a parent-side setpgid after posix_spawn fails with EACCES once the child has exec'd. Configuration.timeout now has a doc comment stating POSIX kills only the direct child and Windows the whole job; a Linux test (sh -c 'sleep 2 & exec sleep 30', 200 ms timeout) pins that run(_:) returns only after the grandchild closes the pipe. Group kill would need a setpgroup option on ISO_9945 spawn (swift-iso/swift-iso-9945) and kill(-pid) in _watchdogBody.
